Third-Born Tsaxi: "You come from the north house. I know the Broker's children when I see them, and I say that once and no more. I will not explain it. Ask the woman who sent you. A fire went through the upper floors of the Rose. The heirs sent three of their held up to me, to keep until the Rose's leaves came after them. The old woman is held for a roof: she owes the heirs for the shelter they gave her. One of the two young ones is held for words said in the yard.
